geeklist.title: [Ended] Cleanout Sale #10 - 163 Games - Euros, Party, Childrens (Ends 11/25/25)
geeklist.description:
** Auction over at midnight ** Thank you. Will send out messages tonight and tomorrow.
RULES: 1. Unsold items from my previous auction(s) are still available. [geeklist=360241][/geeklist] Note: All items listed on the auctions above are all listed on other marketplaces but I'll do my best to keep the prior auctions and item availability up to date as time allows.
2. Ends sometime during the night (typically between 10pm - Midnight Central) on Tuesday, Nov 25.
3. Shipping: - US addresses only. - Shipping from 63128 (St. Louis, MO). - Local pickup available (South County usually but could also do Game Nite or Miniature Market in Rock Hill). - I do combine shipping and use PirateShip. I ship either via UPS or USPS. I'll send the tracking number to you via Geekmail once I print out the shipping label.
4. Items should have a starting/minimum bid and a Buy it Now (BIN) unless stated otherwise. [b]If you BIN, please let me know if you are ready for checkout.[/b] Please: - Bid in whole dollar amounts only. - Leave your shipping zip code so I can figure out shipping cost. [b]If being shipped to a PO Box, please note that so I know to use USPS rates.[/b] - If you are ready to check out, let me know - I'll get to them soon as I get back in town. - BGG will receive its 3% commission.
5: Payment: Paypal or Venmo. Cash is fine for local pickup.
6. If you have questions please let me know. I also have photos of most everything listed that I can provide if needed.
geeklist.comment: Just FYI. The older auction links at start are inaccessible due to being private.

item.body:
Please read this one carefully and see my images. Actual items in photos.
Base game (1977 Bookcase Box) + Expansions 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6.
